seo.description: Plan Ouarzazate: Kasbah Taourirt, Atlas Film Studios, Aït Benhaddou, Tifoultoute, Fint Oasis and desert-edge roads. Practical tips and a 3-day outline.

name: Ouarzazate
hero_subtitle: Kasbahs, film sets and the gateway between the High Atlas and the desert roads.

info.vibe_val: Desert edge, kasbahs and film-set Morocco
info.airport_val: OZZ Ouarzazate · Road from Marrakech (~4–5 h)

overview.title: Welcome to Ouarzazate — door to the desert
overview.p1: Ouarzazate sits where the High Atlas opens toward the pre-Saharan plateaus. Kasbah Taourirt anchors the town; Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou explain why this place became a film and heritage landmark. From here, roads push east to Skoura and the Dadès, and south into the Draa.
overview.p2: Two or three days cover the town kasbah, a studio visit and Aït Benhaddou, with room for Fint Oasis or Tifoultoute. Stay in town for logistics, or near Skoura for quieter palm-grove nights.

places.title: Must-visit places in Ouarzazate
places.subtitle: Kasbahs, film sets, a UNESCO ksar and palm oases.

taourirt.name: Kasbah Taourirt
taourirt.desc: Former Glaoui stronghold with courtyards and desert-gateway atmosphere.

atlas-studios.name: Atlas Film Studios
atlas-studios.desc: Open-air movie sets — the Hollywood of Morocco on the desert edge.

ait-benhaddou.name: Aït Benhaddou
ait-benhaddou.desc: Iconic earthen fortified village on the old caravan road.

tifoultoute.name: Kasbah Tifoultoute
tifoultoute.desc: Hilltop kasbah with wide views, quieter than the main circuit.

fint.name: Fint Oasis
fint.desc: Palm corridor and village life south of town.

cinema-museum.name: Cinema Museum
cinema-museum.desc: Costumes, props and the story of filming in Ouarzazate.

skoura.name: Skoura Palm Grove
skoura.desc: Vast oasis and kasbahs east toward the Dadès.

souk.name: Ouarzazate Souk
souk.desc: Everyday market streets and local town rhythm.

itinerary.title: 3 days in Ouarzazate
itinerary.subtitle: Town and studios first, then Aït Benhaddou, then oasis or gorge options.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Explore the Glaoui kasbah courtyards and terraces at the edge of town.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Walk the outdoor sets and desert backdrops that made Ouarzazate a film hub.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Simple dinner in the centre; early night if tomorrow is Aït Benhaddou.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Leave early for the UNESCO ksar; climb for the classic panorama.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explore the fortified village, then lunch on the modern bank.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Back to town; optional Cinema Museum if energy remains.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Choose palms and village paths, or a quieter hill kasbah viewpoint.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Palm grove toward the Dadès, or shopping and rest in town.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Continue toward Dadès, Draa/Zagora or back to Marrakech depending on your route.

stays.title: Where to stay in Ouarzazate? Our Favorites
stays.subtitle: Town hotels, kasbah views, and palm-grove lodges toward Skoura: explore our top recommended addresses.

card1.name: Hotel Kasbah Taourirt
card1.desc: Traditional refined stay near historical monuments, offering authentic Saharan ambiance and great comfort.

card2.name: Dar Atlas Ouarzazate
card2.desc: A peaceful sanctuary combining traditional earthen architecture and modern amenities with a bright patio.

card3.name: Hotel des Studios
card3.desc: Located near Atlas Studios, featuring an artistic ambiance inspired by world-famous movie productions.

card4.name: Kasbah Palmeraie Skoura
card4.desc: A true sanctuary of serenity amidst palm groves, ideal for quietness and exploring the southeast trails.

eat.title: Where to eat in Ouarzazate
eat.subtitle: Tagines in town, terrace lunches at Aït Benhaddou and simple hotel restaurants.

nomad.title: Town tagines
nomad.desc: Classic Moroccan plates in the heart of town.

fassia.title: Hotel restaurants
fassia.desc: Reliable and comfortable options after long drives.

moha.title: Aït Benhaddou terraces
moha.desc: Lunch with views over the fortified village.

bacha.title: Simple grills
bacha.desc: Local meat and daily fresh bread.

elfenn.title: Skoura lodges
elfenn.desc: Fixed homemade menus inside the palm grove.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Petit taxis in town; private drivers for Aït Benhaddou, Skoura and Fint. Agree prices before you ride.

bargain.title: Sun & altitude
bargain.desc: Strong sun and dry air year-round. Nights can be cool — pack a layer even in warmer months.

water.title: Day trips
water.desc: Aït Benhaddou is the essential outing. Skoura, Dadès and Draa need more time or an overnight.

daytrips.title: Day trips from Ouarzazate
daytrips.subtitle: UNESCO ksar, palm oases and the first gorges of the east.

ait_benhaddou.name: Aït Benhaddou
ait_benhaddou.desc: UNESCO ksar about 30–40 minutes away — the region’s signature day stop.

dades.name: Dadès Gorge
dades.desc: Road of kasbahs and dramatic gorge landscapes east of Skoura.

draa.name: Draa Valley
draa.desc: Palm corridor and kasbahs south toward Zagora for a longer day or overnight.

q1.question: How many days in Ouarzazate?
q1.answer: Two full days cover Taourirt, Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou. A third day suits Fint, Skoura or the start of a desert route.

q2.question: Is Ouarzazate only a stopover?
q2.answer: It is a logistics hub, but the kasbah, studios and Aït Benhaddou justify one or two nights on their own.

q3.question: How do I get to Ouarzazate?
q3.answer: Ouarzazate Airport (OZZ) has limited flights. Most travellers arrive by road from Marrakech (about 4–5 hours) or continue from the desert circuit.

q4.question: Best time to visit Ouarzazate?
q4.answer: Spring and autumn for milder days. Summer is very hot; winter is clear but cold at night.
